One platform, configured for your sector

Kraal Code is not a one-size-fits-all system. The same platform configures differently for a manufacturer, a consultancy, an NGO, and a retailer. See how it works for your world.

Manufacturing

BOM, routings, work centres, production orders, QC, genealogy, OEE, and yield tracking. From raw materials to finished goods.

Key modules: Accounting, Inventory, Manufacturing, Procurement, HR & Payroll Learn more →

Trading & Distribution

Multi-warehouse inventory, batch tracking, FEFO, inter-branch transfers, landed cost, and distribution management.

Key modules: Accounting, Inventory, Advanced Inventory, Sales, Procurement Learn more →

Non-Profits & NGOs

Donor-restricted fund accounting, project-based budget tracking, multi-currency grant reporting, and logframe reporting.

Key modules: Accounting, Projects, Strategy & BSC, HR & Payroll, Procurement Learn more →

Consultancy & Professional Services

Project billing (T&M and milestone), timesheets, resource allocation, project P&L, and client management.

Key modules: Accounting, Sales & CRM, Projects, HR & Payroll Learn more →

Agriculture & Cooperatives

Outgrower registration, seasonal intake, weighbridge integration, input loan deductions, and mobile money farmer payment.

Key modules: Accounting, Inventory, Outgrower Operations, Procurement Learn more →

Retail & POS

Touch-optimised terminal, barcode scanning, multi-payment modes, mobile money push, thermal receipt, and offline mode.

Key modules: Accounting, Inventory, POS, Sales Learn more →

Hospitality

POS with table mode, inventory management, HR & Payroll, and financial reporting for hotels, restaurants, and lodges.

Key modules: Accounting, Inventory, POS, HR & Payroll Learn more →

Schools & Education

Integration with Academia Pro for school management. Finance, HR, procurement, and reporting for educational institutions.

Key modules: Accounting, HR & Payroll, Procurement, Projects Learn more →
